header.shortDesc: As teens and adults face new oral health challenges, from daily wear and tear on teeth to maintaining gum health, SuperMouth’s dentist-designed systems provide comprehensive care for these stages of life. Whether it’s cavity prevention, enamel strengthening, natural teeth whitening, or reducing bad breath and dental sensitivity, each product in the system works together seamlessly for long-lasting oral wellness. Choose the system that best fits your needs: the Basic System provides minimum recommended oral care, the Plus System adds advanced gum protection and oral health support, and the Complete System offers the ultimate in whole-mouth protection.

tiers.superText: The Complete System is designed for total oral health, combining cavity prevention, enamel strengthening, natural teeth whitening, advanced gum support, and microbiome balance. Every product is powered by Hydroxamin® (nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2), available in both fluoride and non-fluoride options, ensuring full protection for your teeth, gums, and overall oral health. This system is ideal for those who want the highest level of care, addressing every aspect of oral health, including bad breath and dental sensitivity, for a complete mouth care solution.

items.q: Why is it important to use an oral care system for teens & adults?
items.a: As a teen or adult, maintaining optimal oral health is crucial not just for a beautiful smile but also for overall well-being. This stage often involves addressing more advanced oral care needs, such as preventing gum disease, managing sensitivity, and maintaining strong, healthy teeth. Our system is specifically designed to meet these needs while nurturing your oral microbiome—a vital community of beneficial bacteria that supports both oral and systemic health. Additionally, our products are formulated with ingredients that can naturally whiten teeth, helping you achieve a brighter smile safely and effectively.

items.q: Why should I choose a system versus buying individual products?
items.a: Our systems for teens and adults are expertly curated by leading dentists and medical experts to ensure that every product works together to provide a complete, effective oral care solution. Choosing a system offers the best value, including educational content that helps you understand and optimize your oral health. Our systems are also available on a convenient subscription basis, so you’ll never run out of essential products, ensuring consistent care that keeps your smile at its best.

items.q: How long does a System last?
items.a: Each System is designed to last 90 days — 3 full months — for the average user. Subscriptions deliver a fresh box every 90 days, with monthly or quarterly payment options, and you can adjust your delivery schedule anytime if your family uses more or less.

items.q: How do SuperMouth systems incorporate advanced features and revolutionary designs?
items.a: Our systems feature groundbreaking, patented technologies that take oral care to the next level. For example, our SuperBristles Pro on our manual SuperBrush line of toothbrushes clean teeth up to an incredible 30X better than typical manual brushes, and they clean up to an astonishing 40X better when used with the Ultim8 SmartBrush System. This system also includes a pressure sensor to protect your gums and a SmartHub with a UV sanitizer, dryer, charger, and built-in rinse cup. Additionally, our products are formulated with ingredients that are not only safe and effective in protecting your entire mouth, but they also naturally whiten teeth, allowing you to enjoy a brighter smile along with superior oral health. These systems come in stunning designs and colors, making your oral care routine not just effective but also a pleasure.

items.q: What accessories can I purchase to complement my teens & adults system?
items.a: Depending on your specific needs, you can enhance your system with a variety of advanced accessories, such as the Ultim8 SmartBrush System for a superior brushing experience or additional tools like water flossers and automatic toothpaste dispensers. These accessories are designed to elevate your oral care routine, ensuring that every aspect of your mouth is well taken care of.

items.q: Can I integrate my teens & adults system into a family oral care plan?
items.a: Absolutely! Our systems are designed to fit seamlessly into family packages, allowing you to select the right system for every family member, whether they’re a child, teen, or an adult. This way, everyone in your household can enjoy the benefits of customized, top-tier oral care.

reviews.name: Nicole
reviews.title: Absolute game-changer for my oral care routine! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.body:
​I am completely obsessed with this entire line! Finding products that are truly free of toxins and unnecessary additives is hard, but finding ones that actually work this well is next-level.
​Here is why I'm never going back:
​The Toothpaste: The vanilla and strawberry flavors are incredible—subtle, refreshing, and not overwhelming. My teeth have literally never felt so silky and smooth. Even when I wake up in the morning, they still feel amazing!
​The Spray: This is my secret weapon. I use it right after acidic foods or drinks to help balance the pH levels in my mouth. Just like the toothpaste, the flavor is gentle, pleasant, and never overpowering.
​The Floss: Hands down, my new favorite. No Teflon, and it actually grabs and removes plaque instead of just sliding right past it or shredding in tight spaces.
​The Tongue Scraper: Super gentle on the tongue while still doing an amazing job clearing away buildup and plaque.
